items.source: Spring Data REST exposes Application-Level Profile Semantics (ALPS) documents, a micro metadata format. To view the ALPS metadata, follow the profile link exposed by the root resource. If you navigate down to the ALPS document for Person resources (which would be /alps/persons), you can find many details about Person resources. Projections are listed, along with the details about the GET REST transition, in blocks similar to the following example:
items.translation: Spring Data REST 会暴露应用级语义配置文件（ALPS）文档，这是一种微元数据格式。要查看 ALPS 元数据，请遵循根资源所暴露的profile链接。如果您导航至Person资源的 ALPS 文档（即/alps/persons），可以找到关于Person资源的许多详细信息。其中列出了投影（Projections）以及关于GETREST 转换的详情，并以如下示例中的块形式呈现：

items.source: The User class in the preceding example can be used to store user information as well as integration with Spring Security. If you create a UserRepository, the password field would normally have been exported, which is not good. In the preceding example, we prevent that from happening by applying Jackson’s @JsonIgnore on the password field.
items.translation: 前例中的 `<User>` 类可用于存储用户信息并与 Spring Security 集成。如果您创建了一个 `<UserRepository>`，`password` 字段通常会被导出，这并不理想。在前例中，我们通过在该 `password` 字段上应用 Jackson 的 `<@JsonIgnore>` 来防止这种情况发生。

items.source: A common situation with REST services arises when you compose domain objects. For example, a Person is stored in one table and their related Address is stored in another. By default, Spring Data REST serves up the person’s address as a URI the client must navigate. But if it is common for consumers to always fetch this extra piece of data, an excerpt projection can put this extra piece of data inline, saving you an extra GET. To do so, you can define another excerpt projection, as follows:
items.translation: 在使用 REST 服务组合领域对象时，常会遇到一种情况。例如，Person 存储在一个表中，而其相关的 Address 存储在另一个表中。默认情况下，Spring Data REST 会将人员的 address 作为客户端必须导航的 URI 提供。但如果消费者经常需要获取这部分额外数据，则可以使用摘录投影（excerpt projection）将该数据内联展示，从而避免一次额外的 GET 请求。为此，您可以定义另一个摘录投影，如下所示：

items.source: In this situation, a Person resource renders the address attribute as a URI to its corresponding Address resource. If we were to look up “Frodo” in the system, we could expect to see a HAL document like this:
items.translation: 在这种情况下，`Person` 资源会将 `address` 属性渲染为指向其对应 `Address` 资源的 URI。如果我们在系统中查找“弗罗多”，我们可能会看到如下所示的 HAL 文档：

items.source: firstName and lastName are data attributes.
items.translation: `firstName` 和 `lastName` 是数据属性。

items.source: There is another way. If the Address domain object does not have its own repository definition, Spring Data REST includes the data fields inside the Person resource, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 还有另一种方法。如果Address领域对象没有自己的仓储定义，Spring Data REST 会将数据字段包含在Person资源中，如下例所示：

items.source: But what if you do not want address details at all? Again, by default, Spring Data REST exports all of its attributes (except the id). You can offer the consumer of your REST service an alternative by defining one or more projections. The following example shows a projection that does not include the address:
items.translation: 那如果您根本不需要 `<address>` 详细信息呢？同样地，默认情况下，Spring Data REST 会导出其所有属性（`<id>` 除外）。您可以通过定义一个或多个投影来为您的 REST 服务消费者提供替代方案。以下示例展示了一个不包含地址的投影：

items.source: To view the projection to the resource, look up localhost:8080/persons/1?projection=noAddresses.
items.translation: 要查看对资源的投影，请查找 localhost:8080/persons/1?projection=noAddresses。

items.source: If such a projection is created and used, it sidesteps the @JsonIgnore directive placed on User.password.
items.translation: 如果创建了此类投影并加以使用，它将绕过针对`User.password` 设置的`@JsonIgnore` 指令。

items.source: The preceding example directs Spring Data REST to use the NoAddresses projection when embedding Person resources into collections or related resources.
items.translation: 前面的示例指示 Spring Data REST 在将 Person 资源嵌入集合或相关资源时使用 NoAddresses 投影。

items.translation: `address` 是另一个域对象的链接。

items.source: Any @Projection interface found in the same package as your entity definitions (or one of its sub-packages) is registered.
items.translation: 与您的实体定义位于同一包（或其子包）中的任何 `@Projection` 接口都会被注册。

items.source: You can manually register a projection by using RepositoryRestConfiguration.getProjectionConfiguration().addProjection(…).
items.translation: 您可以使用 `RepositoryRestConfiguration.getProjectionConfiguration().addProjection(…)` 手动注册投影。

items.source: In either case, the projection interface must have the @Projection annotation.
items.translation: 无论哪种情况，投影接口都必须带有 `@Projection` 注解。

items.source: Flagged with the @Projection annotation and located in the same package (or sub-package) of the domain type, OR

items.translation: 通过手动注册 `RepositoryRestConfiguration.getProjectionConfiguration().addProjection(…)` 实现。

items.source: 1 The @Projection annotation flags this as a projection. The name attribute provides the name of the projection, which we cover in more detail shortly. The types attributes targets this projection to apply only to Person objects. 2 It is a Java interface, making it declarative. 3 It exports the firstName. 4 It exports the lastName.
items.translation:
1 @Projection 注解将此标记为投影。name 属性提供了该投影的名称，我们稍后将更详细地介绍它。types 属性将该投影的目标限定为仅适用于 Person 对象。
2 它是一个 Java 接口，使其具有声明式特性。
3 它导出了 firstName。
4 它导出了 lastName。

items.source: 1 This part of the ALPS document shows details about GET and Person resources. 2 This part contais the projection options. 3 This part contains the noAddresses projection. 4 The actual attributes served up by this projection include firstName and lastName.

items.source: 1 The address data is directly included inline, so you do not have to navigate to get it. 2 The link to the Address resource is still provided, making it still possible to navigate to its own resource.
items.translation: 1 address 数据直接内联包含，因此无需导航即可获取。 2 到 Address 资源的链接仍然提供，因此仍可导航至其自身资源。

items.source: 1 Spring’s @Value annotation lets you plug in a SpEL expression that takes the target object and splices together its firstName and lastName attributes to render a read-only fullName.
items.translation: 1 Spring 的@Value注解允许您插入一个 SpEL 表达式，该表达式接收目标对象并将其firstName和lastName属性拼接起来，以渲染只读的fullName。

items.source: 1 Jackson’s @JsonIgnore is used to prevent the password field from being serialized into JSON.
items.translation: 1 Jackson 的 @JsonIgnore 注解用于防止将 password 字段序列化为 JSON。

items.source: The value supplied to the projection query parameter is the same as that specified in @Projection(name = "noAddress"). It has nothing to do with the name of the projection’s interface.
items.translation: 传递给 projection 查询参数的值与在 @Projection(name = "noAddress") 中指定的值相同，它与投影接口的名称无关。

items.source: See Projections to see an example project. We encourage you to experiment with it.
items.translation: 请参见投影 (Projections)以查看示例项目。我们鼓励您对其进行实验。

items.source: Jackson also does not serialize the field into JSON if @JsonIgnore is on the field’s corresponding getter function.
items.translation: 如果字段对应的 getter 方法上标注了 @JsonIgnore，Jackson 也不会将该字段序列化为 JSON。

items.source: Excerpt projections are not automatically applied to single resources. They have to be applied deliberately. Excerpt projections are meant to provide a default preview of collection data but not when fetching individual resources. See Why is an excerpt projection not applied automatically for a Spring Data REST item resource? for a discussion on the subject.
items.translation: 摘录投影不会自动应用于单个资源，必须手动应用。摘录投影旨在为集合数据提供默认预览，而非在获取单个资源时使用。有关此主题的讨论，请参阅 为什么 Spring Data REST 项目资源不会自动应用摘录投影？。

items.source: Configuring @RepositoryRestResource(excerptProjection=…​) for a repository alters the default behavior. This can potentially cause breaking changes to consumers of your service if you have already made a release.
items.translation: 为存储库配置 @RepositoryRestResource(excerptProjection=…​) 会改变默认行为。如果您已经发布了版本，这可能会导致服务消费者的破坏性变更。

items.source: This example may seem a bit contrived, but it is possible, with a richer domain model and many projections, to accidentally leak such details. Since Spring Data REST cannot discern the sensitivity of such data, it is up to you to avoid such situations.
items.translation: 此示例可能略显牵强，但在拥有更丰富的领域模型和众多投影的情况下，确实可能意外泄露此类细节。由于 Spring Data REST 无法辨别此类数据的敏感性，因此避免此类情况的责任在于您自己。
